audience: on-call and operations teams who page their staff with SIGNL4

useCases.title: Find alerts that are still open
useCases.text: The AI searches alerts by team, status, creation time, text or external id, and opens one for its status, severity and history.

useCases.title: See who is on duty now and later
useCases.text: The AI reads whether users are on or off duty per team, the planned duty schedules with stand-ins and shifts, and the duty summary of a team.

useCases.title: Read what happened to an alert
useCases.text: The AI reads the ordered timeline of an alert: notifications, acknowledgements, annotations and escalations, and who responded.

useCases.title: Report alert volume and response per team
useCases.text: The AI reads acknowledged, closed and unhandled alert counts per team over several periods, overall and per category.

useCases.title: Raise an alert for a team
useCases.text: The AI raises a new alert in a team, with a category if you name one. Everyone on duty is paged, so confirm before it runs.

useCases.title: Acknowledge, annotate or close alerts
useCases.text: The AI acknowledges an alert, adds a note to its timeline, or closes it, on behalf of a SIGNL4 user you name.
